gaps.message: Input-echo assert at line 142 `assert expected_match_count_outside_repo == "0"` is trivially true (test asserts on a string literal it wrote itself); the substantive :172 `assert len(matches_outside_repo) == 0` is what maps to R1.

R4 (SPEC line 127) requires constant SQL count and forbids N+1; the test hardcodes `expected_statement_count_per_request = "4"`. Line 523 pins to exactly 4, which is stricter than the SPEC — an implementation using 3 or 5 statements (still no N+1) would fail. The constant-property check at :561 still catches N+1 violations.

Multiple input-echo asserts (lines 142, 237, 238, 239, 362, 470, 471, 599, 600) are tautological; substantive assertions (172, 271, 310, 318, 398, 523, 561, 607, 620) are the ones that actually fail on requirement violation.
